Game Overview

In Alien Mahjong, the core idea is straightforward: enter the quirky realm of Alien Mahjong, where you must match identical tiles amidst evolving challenges. When traditional pairings fail, unleash bomb mode to mix things up and create fresh matches. Navigate through layered puzzles with strategy and enjoy a festive atmosphere in this delightful puzzle adventure.
